title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating + quality metric integration
author: Priya Shah
commit_summary: feat: add CI hook and runner for prompt-set regression gating
chore: wire new metric exporters into eval harness
test: add regression fixtures and golden outputs
description: Motivation: prevent silent prompt-set regressions and integrate eval metrics into CI gating so that model or prompt changes that regress quality fail PRs automatically. This PR wires a new CI hook that runs a focused subset of the eval-harness prompt-suite (stable prompt sets) as a fast gating step, adds quality metric exporters (EM, BLEU-like, and model scoring hooks) to the runner, and introduces a lightweight threshold configuration for canary PRs. Changes: add a new GH Action workflow (ci/eval-prompt-regression.yml) that spins up the eval runner in container mode; add eval-harness/ci/thresholds.yaml to configure per-suite gates; update eval-harness/runner to export metrics to the CI summary and to the observability-pack local sink; add safeguards so network calls are mocked and time budgets are enforced; update README and docs for running the gating locally. Checklist: - add workflow and runner integration; - add thresholds file and default thresholds for core prompt sets; - add tests and golden fixtures; - add docs and usage notes; - request reviewers for linear ENG-4821. Rationale: this provides a fast, low-cost signal for regressions while full nightly evals remain the source of truth. Impact: small runtime cost on PRs with stronger protection for prompt regressions. Rollout plan: start as opt-in workflow for model onboarding PRs, then enable for all runtime-affecting PRs after 2 weeks of monitoring.
